FN-NDK1TJ-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 154
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Napoleon Bracy
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/17/2023
House Bill 154 as introduced would provide for a two percent salary increase to state employees
effective on the first pay day during fiscal year 2024. This bill would increase the personnel
costs of state agencies by an estimated $44.9 million in fiscal year 2024 and each year thereafter,
with an estimated $14.5 million of this increase paid from the State General Fund.
